rooms_page_description: Keep a local view of the exact mod revision a room shares. Preparing or using it in League always remains your choice.
rooms_service_pending_title: Online rooms are not connected yet
rooms_service_pending_description: This screen currently manages local room drafts only. The upcoming room service will authenticate the code and password, show other members, and exchange the manifest without exposing either credential to the game flow.
rooms_join_description: Enter the room code to create or reopen its local workspace. Neither action connects to a server in this build.
rooms_code_description: Use the code supplied by the room owner. It is stored locally only after you create or open the draft.
rooms_password_description: Password entry is disabled until the authenticated room service is available. A password is not stored in this app.
rooms_password_placeholder: Available when online rooms are connected
rooms_draft_ready_description: The workspace is ready on this device. It is not connected to a remote room.
rooms_open_failed_title: Could not open the room draft
rooms_memberships_description: Drafts saved on this device. Leaving does not uninstall prepared mods or remove the local profile.
rooms_empty_description: Create or open a local draft with a room code to view its synchronization state here.
rooms_leave_failed_title: Could not leave the local workspace
rooms_left_description: Prepared mods and profiles were kept unchanged.
rooms_sync_description: A room service will supply and verify the manifest. This app does not change your enabled mods while data is synchronized.
rooms_sync_no_manifest: There is no accepted manifest on this device yet.
rooms_members_description: Only this device is known in a local draft. The room service will add authenticated members and their real synchronization states.
rooms_member_remote_pending: Other members will appear after the room service connects.
rooms_manifest_description: The exact files and sizes in the accepted room revision. Listing them does not install or enable them.
rooms_manifest_empty_description: An authenticated room connection must accept a manifest before its files can be listed.
rooms_cache_description: Temporary verified files stay outside the mod library until you explicitly prepare a revision.
rooms_cache_pruned_description: Only unreferenced temporary files were removed.
rooms_cache_prune_failed_title: Could not prune the room cache
rooms_workflow_description: Each boundary needs a local click. Creating or selecting a room never installs, enables, patches, or launches anything.
rooms_step_synchronized_ready: Accepted revision {revision} is verified in the isolated room cache.
rooms_step_synchronized_waiting: Wait for the room service to provide a complete, verified revision.
rooms_step_prepared_ready: Revision {revision} was imported as disabled local mods.
rooms_step_prepared_waiting: No accepted revision has been prepared in the local library.
rooms_prepare_description: Imports the accepted revision through the existing library flow. It does not select a profile or apply the mods.
rooms_prepare_done_description: {imported} imported and {reused} already available. They remain disabled.
rooms_prepare_failed_title: Could not prepare the room revision
rooms_step_profile_ready: A dedicated non-active room profile is ready for revision {revision}.
rooms_step_profile_waiting: Prepare the same accepted revision before creating its dedicated profile.
rooms_profile_description: Creates or updates a dedicated profile without selecting it.
rooms_profile_done_description: Choose it yourself in Mods when you want to use it.
rooms_profile_failed_title: Could not create the room profile
rooms_step_applied_selected: The room profile is currently selected. Start or Play remains a separate manual action.
rooms_step_applied_waiting: Choose the dedicated profile in Mods, then use the existing Start or Play flow when you decide to apply it.
rooms_workflow_unavailable: Preparation becomes available only after an accepted, synchronized revision exists.
